items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: they had a drummer, Jasper Taylor, playing in that band. And Jasper, one of his girlfriends came in one night, shot at him on the stage.

ctx.x: And they were household names, and people --

Oh, yeah, right. Everybody knew them. I mean, the whole family, the whole personnel. And it was a funny thing, they had a drummer, Jasper Taylor, playing in that band. And Jasper, one of his girlfriends came in one night, shot at him on the stage.
